about.en: The original Claus (CLAUS) token, the ERC-20 at 0x1b54E762aa34CF6E28E9C082F2848e28E45DA6b8 on Ethereum. The project moved its token and liquidity to Robinhood Chain (claus, 0x163015276f3244bC2CcB78b4D69cc8A4069EfFAC) and calls this one retired: holders at the snapshot (Ethereum block 26357823) received the new token, and buying the old one after it gives no allocation. Centralized exchanges that listed CLAUS before the move (Weex, and formerly MEXC and BingX) trade this Ethereum token, at a far lower unit price than the Robinhood Chain token.
